Card Q&A.q: Is the condition "if this Digimon has 7 link cards" in this card's [All Turns] effect still met if this Digimon has 8 or more link cards?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link up to 7 [Appmon] trait cards with different names from this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the costs. Then, this Digimon may attack without suspending.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, you may delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if this Digimon has 7 link cards, return your opponent's top security card to the bottom of the deck.
